mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.0%), a federal funds rate above 2.0% signals persistent monetary tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,150,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1150.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 104.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 104.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when nonfarm payrolls increase for 3 consecutive months.
